text_block_list.text: The day of the race between Super Creek and the umamusume trained by the veteran trainer—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan, thanks for coming all the way to cheer me on~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wawa!? Don't go tryin' to pat my head right away, ya hear!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I put ya through a real grueling workout, ya hear?
So ya better show me what ya got out there!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do my absolute best~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
How are you holding up, Trainer?
Are you feeling nervous at all?
choice_data_list: I feel like I should be the one asking that...
I feel like I'm supposed to ask you that...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You might be right, but I just couldn't help worrying about you~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing just fine.
Besides, Trainer gave me plenty of encouraging words about winning.

text_block_list.name: Top-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, rookie Trainer, and Super Creek.
It seems you've put in a decent amount of training.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good morning~, let's have a great match today.

text_block_list.name: Top-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You seem quite relaxed. I suppose that means
you've prepared yourself for the transfer.
choice_data_list: Super Creek isn't going to lose.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, my... when did you grow so strong and capable?♪

text_block_list.name: Top-Tier Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I, I see you two are close, but that ends today.
I've prepared a training menu for Super Creek, and I'll be waiting.
They walked away, looking entirely confident in their victory.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've finished my greetings to our opponent.
I'll be heading off now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This race isn't an official one, but...
I'll be sure to present you with my first victory~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'll do my very best♪

And so, the race between Super Creek and the Horsegirl
managed by the Veteran Trainer finally began.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... hah... hah...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*... *pant*... *pant*... *pant*...
They really are fast~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I won't let all that training with Trainer
and Tama-chan go to waste!

Even though the race had only just begun,
Super Creek steadily accelerated forward.
This is just like how she ran during the debut tryout—or maybe even faster...

text_block_list.name: Top-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't even covered half the distance,
and she's already launching her final spurt!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, you got it all wrong. That's just how Creek runs.
She's had the chops to debut whenever she wanted all along.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The only reason she held off till now is 'cause
her Trainer was keepin' a sharp eye on her every step.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Because Creek wasn't feelin' 100% physically, see...

text_block_list.name: Top-Class Trainer
text_block_list.text: She was in poor condition...!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, you didn't know?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
For the first two or three days after you became her trainer, she wasn't at her best.
She probably didn't want to worry you, so she kept quiet about it.
I thought I was failing to adjust the training properly because I was a rookie, but she was actually feeling under the weather...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...But she still adjusted the training for you, didn't she? She was happy, saying, 'The Trainer is growing every day.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Even if you misunderstood the situation, the fact that you were watching Creek with such seriousness hasn't changed, has it?
I'm still a rookie, and I'll probably just keep letting her pamper me...!
choice_data_list: I'll lead you to victory and prove I'm a pro!
I'll lead you to victory and prove I'm a pro!

text_block_list.text: I shouted with all my might toward Super Creek as she ran the course.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want to pamper you too, so I'll do my best!!
This race, with the transfer on the line, ended in a landslide victory for Super Creek.
Some time later—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Our debut is finally drawing near.
I'm already getting nervous~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, then I must help you relax. It's okay, it's okay, you're a strong child, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We'll debut, stack up the wins, and win the big races too...
I'll make you into a splendid trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So please, let me pamper you as much as you like, Trainer♪
